What is the new volume when an expandable 4.51 L container of gas at 273 K is warmed to 546 K?
V = [?]L
Assume that the number of moles and the pressure remain constant.
judge_reasoning: The correct computation is V2 = V1*(T2/T1) = 4.51*(546/273) = 9.02 L. Candidate 1 gives 9.02 L with consistent Charles’s law setup, so it is correct. Candidates 2 (10.05 L), 3 (~8.99 L from an incorrect multiplication), and 4 (9 L) all produce incorrect final values, so they score much lower despite similar formulas.
